questions.question: God told Aaron and his sons to treat the sacred offerings with respect. Why?

answers.text: So they do not profane His holy name
So the people keep bringing more
So the altar stays clean and ready

questions.question: What did God say must happen to a descendant of Aaron who approached the sacred offerings while unclean?

answers.text: He must be cut off from God's presence
He must pay the priests in silver
He must leave the camp for a month

questions.question: God said a peace offering brought to fulfill a vow could have a small blemish and still be acceptable. True or false?
When God told the priests to keep His charge over the sacred offerings, who did He say makes them holy?
